title: D-Wave delivers Advantage2 quantum computer to Italy
key_facts: D-Wave Advantage2 annealing quantum computer arrived in Como, Lombardy, Italy
Installed at Villa Saporiti; funded by Swiss Quantum Technology SA under a 10 million euro agreement
Called VoltaB1 within the Q-Alliance ecosystem
SQT holds 50% of capacity for five years with an option to buy the full system
Accessible via D-Wave Leap cloud once installed
Formal inauguration at Q-Alliance event on 16 Oct 2026
quote_evidence: Funded by Swiss Quantum Technology SA, the system, referred to within the Q-Alliance ecosystem as the VoltaB1, will give European researchers, universities and businesses access to powerful, production-grade annealing quantum computing technology once installed.
Under the agreement, SQT acquired 50% of the system's capacity for five years and holds an option to purchase the full system.
why_it_matters_hint: First annealing quantum computer in Italy, with cloud access for European users.
notes: Data Center Dynamics blocked (403); read The Quantum Insider, which republishes D-Wave press release. Italy first claim is D-Wave and Q-Alliance wording.
